scene: On a muddy Norwegian farm hillside at dawn, Thora, huge and expressive in the foreground (nine-year-old girl, cream round face, chestnut hair in two messy braids, pale yellow wool dress with a brown belt, a single green glass bead on a cord at her neck, black mitten hands), holds a small wooden toy sword in one hand and a drop spindle in the other, staring in exhausted disbelief, while behind her the escaped sheep bolts through a hole in the fence, a bucket of water lies spilled and a heap of firewood waits by the turf-roofed longhouse. Visible hardship: a child's whole to-do list at once.

On a frozen fjord lake under a pale winter sky, Thora, huge and expressive in the foreground (chestnut braids under a brown wool hood, pale yellow dress under a brown cloak, green glass bead, black mitten hands), glides on bone skates pushing with a pole and grinning triumphantly, while behind her small Orm (seven-year-old boy, black hair, fine dark blue cloak) sprawls flat on the ice and Eirik (red-brown beard, teal tunic, brown cloak) sneaks onto the ice wearing a second pair of bone skates. Visible hardship: frozen fingers and endless falls, but a rare joy.
